questions.question: What does Ezekiel 42 describe?
options: The great bronze altar standing in the middle of the court
The side chambers/rooms for the priests in the temple area
The wide river of water flowing out from the threshold
The east gate through which the glory of the LORD came
questions.answer: The side chambers/rooms for the priests in the temple area

questions.question: What were these holy chambers used for?
options: Where priests ate offerings and kept garments
Where all the people gathered to hear the holy law
Where the temple treasures were stored
Where the king sat to judge the people
questions.answer: Where priests ate offerings and kept garments
